text:
lena: Quick kickoff — co-launch storyboard for CloudWave marketplace listing + benchmark blog + webinar. Need owners for launch post, benchmark narrative, webinar ops, and inbound routing. Target launch window: Wed May 20. Can folks take owners? :megaphone:

sam: I can own promotion + social cadence. Need assets and an embargo date for paid spend planning.

devin: I can run the perf tests next week. Which metrics are we prioritizing? p50/p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, and throughput (rps) make sense.

maria: Sales ask: need a lead routing matrix — HubSpot campaign vs SFDC campaign mapping, and partner attribution rules so partner reps get notified.

brian: I'll draft the inbound routing matrix. Confirm fields: utm_source, utm_campaign, partner_id, demo_request boolean, campaign_id?

lena: Yes. Put it in the Notion doc as a table. Also need two short partner/customer quotes, final logo assets, and a short explainer paragraph for the integration value prop.

devin: Will include a reproducibility folder with scripts. Quick example command for the bench harness:

```
# quick smoke test against hosted API
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-13b","input":"hello"}'
```

sam: Webinar proposal: Tue May 19 10:00 PT, 45 min total — 30 min demo, 10 min benchmark highlights, 5 min Q&A. Panel: lena (host) + devin (engineering) + CloudWave PM. Thoughts?

maria: That works. I'll set up the HubSpot form and mapping. Routing: if utm_partner=cloudwave then assign to partner-sdr queue; flag as co_launch_cloudwave campaign.

lena: Marketing assets checklist: blog draft, benchmark deck, webinar deck, landing page, 3 email copies (invite/reminder/follow-up), social creative (8 assets), 2 GIFs, 1 demo clip (60s). Can we get a cleancut benchmark viz — p95 vs cost scatter + simple table?

devin: Yes — I'll export CSV and produce p50/p95 charts and a cost-per-token scatter. Baseline models list I plan to include: Llama2-13b, redwood-13b-quant, VendorA-13b.

brian: Ops note: legal for co-marketing assets and press needs to sign off. I'll ping legal and record the timeline.

sam: Promo timeline draft: teaser 2 weeks prior, announce + blog day-of, webinar 1 week after, nurture sequence for 2 weeks. Paid social to run day-of + 3 days following.

maria: Inbound qualification: MQL if company_size >= 50 AND intent includes "production" or "evaluating infra". Then notify AE and partner rep simultaneously.

lena: Action owners: lena — blog & webinar copy; sam — promo + socials; devin — benchmarks + demo; brian — inbound routing + legal; maria — HubSpot mapping + form. Deadline for first drafts: Tue May 5 EOD. Everyone okay? :white_check_mark:

devin: Quick question — include raw scripts and seed prompts for benchmark reproducibility? I recommend yes so partners/press can verify.

lena: Agreed. Add reproducibility folder in the repo and a short README describing test harness and env.

opsbot: Reminder: reserved calendar slot Tue May 19 17:00 UTC for the webinar. (automated)

sam: I'll create the public Notion planning doc and share here. Draft link: https://redwood.notion.site/Co-Launch-CloudWave-2140005555

maria: I'll drop the HubSpot field mapping and UTM table in the Notion doc within 24h.

brian: Pinged legal (elaine-legal) for co-brand approvals. ETA 48 hours.

elaine-legal: Thanks — we'll need final press release copy and logo pack by May 10 to clear for joint press. Also please confirm trademark usage guidelines in the doc.

lena: Noted — we'll bundle trademark usage and example copy. Benchmark narrative draft note: be conservative in claims, e.g., "up to 2–4x lower cost at comparable quality and ~99ms p50" rather than absolute statements.

devin: I'll upload the CSV and charts by Mon May 4 and include a short methods section.

sam: Tracking snippet for landing page (for dev to drop in):

```
<script>
window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
function trackLaunch(ev){dataLayer.push(ev)}
trackLaunch({event:"co_launch", partner:"cloudwave", campaign:"cloudwave_co_launch_may2025"});
</script>
```

maria: One quick operational Q: who will moderate the live Q&A? Suggest lena.

lena: I'll moderate.

devin: Need CloudWave sandbox creds for live demo testing — @brian can you confirm access for dev and me?

brian: Confirmed — invited devin + lena to cloudwave-sandbox@cloudwave.com and shared demo dataset.

lena: Thanks. Everyone: check assignments in the Notion doc and add blockers in this thread. I'll compile a launch checklist after first drafts. :rocket:
